scope_note: Covers what the Court of Appeal (Criminal Division) decided in Graham Andrew Evans v R [2025] EWCA Crim 1150: the grounds of appeal, the test applied to decide whether the appellant was a public officer, and the disposal. The correctness of the sentence, and the separate gross negligence manslaughter count on which the appellant was acquitted at half time, are out of scope.

steps.title: Locate the judgment
steps.detail: Search Find Case Law in the Court of Appeal Criminal Division for the parties. The neutral citation in the question is given as '[2025] EWCA' with no court abbreviation or number, so the case has to be identified from the party names.

steps.title: Read the judgment and identify what was actually decided
steps.detail: Retrieve the full text and establish the grounds of appeal, the test the court applied to public officer status, the court's reasons for rejecting each ground, and the disposal.
